fusions.name: Carved Portion
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Clear the Table
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 18 blood damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to the hit. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Share the Kill
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Field-Dressed
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
